readings.name: Copilot releases past the newest capture
readings.means: How many published Copilot CLI releases sit between the newest version with fixtures in test/fixtures/ and the one installed here. The footer, dialog and Shift+Tab readers and the events.jsonl parser are proven against real captures of those versions only; each release past them is one nobody has looked at, and the first sign of a break is a phone blocked on a screen the reader no longer recognises. Absent when the installed version, the fixtures or the npm registry cannot be read.

readings.name: Copied host rules with nothing binding them
readings.means: How many rules this plugin keeps its own copy of from the waterplane host or the plugin contract (the ask-rule matcher and the gate's words, the typed-reason check, the composer anchors, the key, hold and command-list bounds; each marked `twin: <name>` in a source comment) that no two-sided check in test/twins.mjs binds, or whose plugin-side check fails. The live host side is checked by `npm test` when the main repo is built, not by this reading, so a change in the host shows as a failing test, never here. A copy nobody marked is not counted. A copy nothing binds drifts silently: the 2026-10-29 D6 and the 2026-11-01 allow-all bugs were both a copy that answered differently from its original.
